tests.tdd_red: cash API test expected401, got404 before route implementation; first SQL focused replay detected missing PL/pgSQL label, fixed before green replays

benchmark.environment: disposable local PostgreSQL17; no hosted network SLA

decisions: cash_units is a private financial auxiliary, with no corporate units or business seed
configuration lists each paginate50 with explicit totals; unit filter available; dashboard sizes3/5
configuration writes return resource and official first configuration page; open returns official own dashboard first page5
all financial write commands serialize on existing office lock and revalidate identity/capabilities after waits
account linked to a session or method cannot change unit/type; no deactivation of units/accounts while affected sessions open; method deactivation blocked while any session in its unit open
session stores operator/unit/account display snapshots; immutable opening movement counted once; received/applied zero
private tables have RLS and no raw client/service_role ACL; public wrappers invoker; private privileged entrypoints auth/capabilitychecked with empty search_path
base has no generated schema client types; shared/cash.ts types and server DTO validate RPC projection without exposing private tables
limitations: No hosted mutation, production advisor run, commit or push performed by domain worker
Hosted network latency and future payment/closing flows are outside this benchmark/task
UI/browser/Auth end-to-end and publication belong to controller
